appContext.summary: The official guest guide to Abhi & Alisha's wedding week at a resort in Cancún: every celebration's schedule with dress codes, RSVP lookup by name, an outfit builder for each event, announcements from the couple, family chat, and a Wedding Week photo album as it happens. Works offline. Warm editorial aesthetic: aged cream paper, antique gold, Playfair italic serif and Cormorant text, string lights, paper-texture cards. On iPad the layouts are roomier: the schedule shows tall invitation cards with attire photo previews.
forbiddenInterpretations: wedding planning marketplace or vendor directory

theme.style: Warm editorial wedding stationery world: aged cream paper, antique gold leaf, and soft blush, warmed by dusk light over a Caribbean sea. Lighting is gentle golden hour with faint bokeh like distant string lights. Surfaces carry fine paper grain, deckled softness, and delicate gold foil shimmer. Backgrounds stay calm, airy and luxurious, never loud, with generous open space at the top for the serif headline.
theme.headlineFont: font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-style: italic; font-weight: 500; @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@1,500&display=swap');
